title: The call floats over the reader in a window the learner can move and resize

tasks.title: Window geometry, placement and the saved position
The floating window with sizes, keyboard moves, menu and visible tiles
The window over a real page, dragged and resized

acs.text: WHILE a call is live THE SYSTEM SHALL render the call window in the persistent mount with fixed positioning over the reader, and opening, moving, resizing or closing it SHALL leave the reader's text column box and scroll position unchanged
scenarios: AC-001 the window never moves the text

acs.text: WHEN a call window opens with no saved position THE SYSTEM SHALL place it at the top inline-end corner (right in the English interface, left in the Hebrew one), 16px inside the inline-end inset and 16px below the top inset (insets from spec 036, or its fallback)
scenarios: AC-002 the default place is the top inline-end corner

acs.text: WHEN the learner picks a size THE SYSTEM SHALL show it: pill (about 240 by 48: avatars, speaking ring, microphone toggle, expand), small, the default (about 320 by 200: the active speaker large, others in a strip), medium (about 480 by 300: a grid of up to 4), large (a grid of up to 9, at most 60% of the viewport in each dimension); more participants than tiles show as "+N"

WHEN the learner drags the window by its handle THE SYSTEM SHALL move it with the pointer and, on release, snap it to the nearest corner 16px inside the insets; a drag that starts on a tile or a control SHALL not move it
scenarios: AC-004 dragging by the handle snaps to a corner

acs.text: WHEN the learner drags the corner resize handle THE SYSTEM SHALL resize the window between the small and large sizes, keeping the tile area at 16:10
WHEN the viewport, the window's size or the insets change THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the whole window inside the area within the insets
scenarios: AC-006 the window stays on screen

acs.text: WHEN a window closes and a later call opens THE SYSTEM SHALL restore the last corner, offset and size from `localStorage`; WHEN storage is unavailable or holds an invalid value it SHALL use the default without an error
scenarios: AC-007 the place is remembered, and bad storage is harmless

acs.text: WHEN the handle has keyboard focus THE SYSTEM SHALL move the window 16px per arrow key (64px with Shift), offer a menu with the four corners and the sizes, and announce each move in a polite live region
WHILE the window is open THE SYSTEM SHALL not trap focus; Escape SHALL collapse it to the pill; every control SHALL be at least 24 by 24px with a visible focus ring and an accessible name
scenarios: AC-009 the window is not a modal

acs.text: WHEN the learner prefers reduced motion THE SYSTEM SHALL move, snap and resize the window without animation
WHILE a participant's tile is not shown (pill size, beyond the visible tiles) THE SYSTEM SHALL not receive their video and SHALL keep playing their audio
scenarios: AC-011 hidden tiles keep their audio
